description:
Tune valve weights for the three-layer root-zone irrigation template.

Same payment as autotune_template: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, and
a missing key or an empty pack is HTTP 402 for x402. The default study is
physics-v1. Pass study_version published to run the older scenario.

max_trials.description: Optuna trials for the root-zone irrigation plant. Default 20. Values below 1 are raised to 1. Paid at $2.00: X-API-Key spends 2 autotune credits, or HTTP 402 is x402 Base USDC. Each call starts a new study.

study_version.description: Omit for physics-v1 (start [0.17, 0.22, 0.22], horizon 9). published keeps the older start-on-reference horizon 24 scenario.

name: autotune_root_zone_irrigation
title: Autotune root-zone irrigation
